title: Key-aware diff for CSV/Parquet/Arrow files with git and DVC integration
user: Data engineer or analyst who keeps Parquet/CSV snapshots in a repo or DVC and needs added/removed/changed rows and columns between two versions — at millions of rows — as a terminal summary and an HTML report.
smallest_useful_product: tdiff a.parquet b.parquet --key id prints row counts added/removed/modified, per-column change counts, schema differences and sample changed rows; --html writes a self-contained report; a git difftool driver plus .gitattributes recipe; Python API returning Arrow tables of diffs. Built on DuckDB.
constraints: Memory for unkeyed diffs; floating-point tolerance semantics must be explicit; no data leaves the machine.
